nodes.text: John! Wonderful to see you. This gala is important—women's leadership in politics needs our support.

moodVariations.Stressed: John! This gala is important—women's leadership needs support.
moodVariations.Relaxed: John! Wonderful to see you! This gala is great!
moodVariations.Neutral: John! Wonderful to see you. This gala is important.

publicOptions.text: Olivia! You look great. How's the committee work going?
Important, yes. Also important: the donors in this room.
Working the room, Olivia. Catch you later.

privateThoughts.text: Reliable colleague. Alliance valuable if maintained.

nodes.text: Good. Because I've been thinking about your workplace equality bill. Section four needs work, but the core is solid.

moodVariations.Stressed: Your workplace equality bill—section four needs work, core is solid.
moodVariations.Relaxed: I've been thinking about your bill! Section four needs work, but it's solid!
moodVariations.Neutral: I've been thinking about your workplace equality bill.

publicOptions.text: I'd value your input. Let's work on it together.
Section four is carefully drafted. What's your concern?
Thanks, Olivia. That means a lot coming from you.

nodes.text: True. Politics isn't just principles—it's resources. Speaking of which, Victoria's been asking about you.

moodVariations.Stressed: Politics is resources. Victoria's been asking.
moodVariations.Relaxed: True! Also resources. Victoria's asking about you!
moodVariations.Neutral: Politics isn't just principles. Victoria's been asking.

publicOptions.text: Victoria Ashford? What does she want?
I'll talk to her if our values align.

nodes.text: Of course. Work the room. We'll talk later.

delayed.effect: Olivia less supportive during legislation debate

nodes.text: I'd like that. Two voices carrying the bill is better than one. Let's schedule time next week.

moodVariations.Stressed: Two voices is better than one. Schedule next week.
moodVariations.Relaxed: I'd like that! Let's schedule next week!
moodVariations.Neutral: I'd like that. Let's schedule time next week.

nodes.text: The enforcement mechanism is too weak. Without teeth, it's just symbolism. You know I'm right.

moodVariations.Stressed: Enforcement is too weak. Without teeth, it's symbolism.
moodVariations.Relaxed: The enforcement mechanism's too weak! You know I'm right.
moodVariations.Neutral: The enforcement mechanism is too weak.

publicOptions.text: Fair point. Let's discuss strengthening it.
Weak enforcement was a deliberate compromise.

nodes.text: She's a major donor. Powerful, demanding, expects loyalty. I'll introduce you if you're interested.

moodVariations.Stressed: Major donor. Powerful, demanding. I'll introduce you.
moodVariations.Relaxed: She's a major donor! Powerful! I'll introduce you!
moodVariations.Neutral: She's a major donor. I'll introduce you if interested.

nodes.text: Good working with you, John. Let's keep in touch.

moodVariations.Stressed: Good working with you. Keep in touch.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Great working with you! Let's keep in touch!
